title: FACT: code and campaign data for 'Who Opened This Connection? Per-Execution Network Attribution, Accounting, and Control for AI Agents'
description: Raw event logs, run plans, scores, and environment snapshots of every campaign used in the paper (confirmatory campaigns and the pilots used to size them), with SHA-256 checksums. The code and analysis pipeline are in the accompanying repository; campaigns/<campaign_id>/checksums.sha256 there verifies each archive.
notes: Co-authors and the paper DOI are added before publication.
